news.headline: Caterpillar Drops 7% as Moderate Sales Outlook Overshadows Beat; Deere Sits Out the Selloff, PACCAR Dips
news.summary: Caterpillar crushed earnings estimates and posted record orders stretching into 2030, yet the stock cratered while its machinery rivals barely flinched. The gap between what Wall Street expected and what management delivered reveals a fault line worth understanding before the next quarterly test arrives.

news.headline: ecobee Introduces Home Summary to Simplify the Connected Home
news.summary: TORONTO, October 29, 2026--ecobee today introduced Home Summary, an opt-in AI-powered feature that provides a convenient and comprehensive daily summary of meaningful household activity in the ecobee app. By bringing together information across heating, cooling, security, occupancy, and weather, Home Summary helps customers understand what's happening in and around their home.
